title: Overhauled Vanilla
description: An amazing, Overhauled Vanilla+ experience! With amazing, but beefy mods.
body:
## **Overhauled Vanilla**

This ModPack features many great, and overhaul-ing mods to upgrade the vanilla experience. Ive made this modpack randomly as my main modpack but its become so big and great, i thought to upload it to modrinth. This modpack requiers at least 8GB of RAM and its a pretty beefy modpack, most of the mods can be configed and customized to your liking!
If you like this mod pack, it would be great if you could sunscribe to [my YT channel.](https://youtube.com/@lmonix-lmon?si=0Vzn57ST4k-tLgoc) It would greatly help me out!
And thank you for trying out this ModPack
